questions.question: A project has 5 tasks. Task B must be completed before Task C, and Task A must be completed before Task D. Which sequence is valid?
questions.reasoning: B must occur before C and A must occur before D.

questions.question: All developers are problem solvers. Some problem solvers are team leaders. Which statement must be true?
options: No problem solver is a developer
questions.reasoning: The first statement directly establishes that every developer belongs to the problem-solver group.

questions.question: Three employees A, B, and C work on different tasks: testing, development, and documentation. A does not work on testing. B does not work on documentation. If C works on testing, what task does A perform?
questions.reasoning: C takes testing. B cannot take documentation, so B takes development. Therefore A takes documentation.

questions.question: A team has four members: A, B, C, and D. A is more experienced than B. C is less experienced than D. B is more experienced than C. Who is the least experienced?
questions.reasoning: A > B > C and D > C, so C is less experienced than both B and D and therefore is the least experienced.

questions.question: A team processes 120 applications in 4 hours. At the same rate, how many applications can it process in 7 hours?
questions.reasoning: The rate is 120 ÷ 4 = 30 applications per hour. In 7 hours, 30 × 7 = 210.

questions.question: A product price increases from 800 to 920. What is the percentage increase?
evaluation_points: Uses the original value as the base

questions.question: What number comes next in the sequence: 3, 6, 12, 24, 48, ?
What number comes next: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, ?
questions.reasoning: The differences are 3, 5, 7, and 9. The next difference is 11, so 26 + 11 = 37.

questions.question: A production system suddenly becomes slow after a new release. What should be the first step?
options: Identify and measure the source of the performance problem
Delete the new release without investigation
questions.correct_answer: Identify and measure the source of the performance problem
questions.reasoning: A structured troubleshooting process should first identify the cause using evidence before selecting a solution.

questions.question: Two important tasks have the same deadline. One task blocks three other tasks, while the other does not block any task. Which should normally be handled first?
options: The task that blocks three other tasks
The task that was created first
questions.correct_answer: The task that blocks three other tasks
questions.reasoning: A dependency-blocking task has a greater effect on the overall workflow and should normally be prioritized.
